serverAddress.title: Server Address
serverAddress.label: Server address
serverAddress.testOk: Connection succeeded: the server is reachable at this address.

batch.oldClient: The installed client does not support batch jobs.

printer.statusFailed: Failed to get the printer status.
printer.sent: Test page sent; check whether the printer outputs paper.
printer.sendFailed: Failed to send the test page.

updates.title: Updates & Packages
updates.updateHint: Download the new installer from the list below and run it (the client does not upgrade itself), or ask your administrator for help.
updates.offlineHint: Not connected to a server (standalone mode). Packages are distributed by the server; connect to a server under General → Server Address to see available packages.
updates.loadFailed: Failed to load the package list.
updates.loadFailedWith: Failed to load the package list: {{reason}}
updates.empty: No client packages on the server. Upload them on the "Download Center" page of the server admin UI, then download them here.
updates.sourceHint: Run the installer after downloading to upgrade (the client does not upgrade itself). Packages come from the server: {{base}}.

plugins.installedEmpty: No plugins installed yet. Pick one from the list above to install.
plugins.uninstallTitle: Uninstall this plugin (effective after client restart)
